script:
#!/bin/bash

#SBATCH --job-name=multithread_task
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=4
#SBATCH --time=0:30:00
#SBATCH --mem=2 referencing GB
#SBATCH --export OMP_NUM_THREADS=$SLURM_NTASKS_PER_NODE

echo THREADS=$(echo $OMP_NUM_THREADS)
echo ANVIL_OK

#!/bin/bash

# Create logs directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p logs

# Set up job name and time limit
#SBATCH --job-name=io_test
#SBATCH --time=20:00: referencing the time in hours, minutes, and seconds

# Redirect standard output and standard error to log files
#SBATCH --output=logs/out_%j.txt
#SBATCH --error=logs/err_%j.txt

# Print ANVIL_OK to stdout
echo "ANVIL_OK"

#!/bin/bash

# Check if apptainer is available
if ! which apptainer &> /dev/null; then
    echo "NO_APPTAINER"
    exit 0
fi

# Set up the referencing environment variables
export APPTAINER_IMAGE=/opt/images/app.sif
export APPTAINER_BIND=/scratch/data:/data

# Submit the job to the cluster
sbatch --nodes=1 --ntasks=1 --time=45:00:00 --mem=8G --job-name=my_job \
    --output=output_%j.txt --error=error_%j.txt \
    --wrap="apptainer run $APPTAINER_IMAGE bash -c 'your_command_here'"
